# Pip-level pins for the prodva-poison-gen environment.
#
# Versions marked [pyproject] are copied verbatim from
# third_party/ProDVa/pyproject.toml @ ff2d41c so the baseline we reproduce runs
# on the same stack the authors specified.
#
# NOTE: pyproject.toml lists `faiss == 1.9.0`, which is not installable from
# PyPI (there is no `faiss` distribution there; it is a conda-only name).
# faiss is therefore installed by conda instead — see conda-prodva-poison-gen.yml.
# Because of that, ProDVa must be installed with `pip install --no-deps`.

torch==2.7.0                    # [pyproject]
transformers==4.51.3            # [pyproject]
numpy==1.26.4                   # [pyproject]
datasets==3.6.0                 # [pyproject]
peft==0.14.0                    # [pyproject]
Django==5.2.1                   # [pyproject]
langchain==0.3.25               # [pyproject]
langchain-community==0.3.25     # [pyproject]
langchain-core==0.3.65          # [pyproject]
langchain-huggingface==0.3.0    # [pyproject]
langchain-text-splitters==0.3.8 # [pyproject]
accelerate                      # [pyproject]
click                           # [pyproject]
tqdm                            # [pyproject]
spacy                           # [pyproject]
nltk                            # [pyproject]
typing_extensions               # [pyproject]
pytest                          # [pyproject]

# Required by dvagen.configs.parser (simple_parsing) but MISSING from pyproject.toml.
# Without it, `dvagen eval` crashes at import.
simple_parsing

# faiss: pyproject pins `faiss==1.9.0` (conda-only name). The conda-forge faiss-GPU
# solve exhausts memory on the only internet-capable nodes here, and the pytorch-channel
# GPU build needs glibc>=2.32 (LS6 has 2.28). faiss-cpu gives IDENTICAL results on this
# exact IndexFlatL2; the one GPU-transfer call is neutralized by env/shims/sitecustomize.py.
faiss-cpu==1.9.0

# Not in pyproject.toml but required at runtime:
# langchain_huggingface.HuggingFaceEmbeddings (retriever.py:54) is a thin wrapper
# around sentence-transformers, which is an optional extra and so never gets
# pulled in by the pins above.
sentence-transformers==4.1.0

# Download tooling for the checkpoint and corpus.
huggingface_hub[hf_transfer]
